summary: Tantech Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing that effective October 1, 2026, Ms. Yefang Zhang resigned as director and Chairman of the Board, with the filing stating the resignation was not due to any disagreement over operations, policies, or practices. The remaining directors elected Mr. Yao L Xu as director and Chairman the same day; he is a Class III director whose term expires at the 2027 annual meeting. No compensation, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory terms were disclosed. The abrupt chair transition with no named successor rationale is the key governance risk-arb angle to watch.
